GD-014.acceptanceScope: Pinned captured Cobble City 5x6: all 30 cells, 49 orthogonal edges, zones and absence of multi-zone cells, unique production start slots for both hero orders, four world-coordinate controls. Automatic slots are observed behavior; player-selected legal setup remains GD-016, UE hit-test remains later integration.

GD-015.acceptanceScope: Production maneuver and pending MOVE distinguish allied/enemy intermediate fighters and forbid occupied endpoints; ranged uses adjacency OR zone intersection with legacy fallback; AStar, direct path execution and AI regression checks. All 37 GD-015 checks pass; full ACC-017 still requires GD-016 and UE.

GD-016.acceptanceScope: Concurrent hero selection serialized via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the game row with in-transaction LOBBY re-check (selectHero) and atomic LOBBY->IN_PROGRESS transition under the same lock (startGame); proven on real PostgreSQL (disposable container, production GameService via real Prisma: deterministic before/after race proof, 15 race rounds, 10 reselect-vs-start rounds, 5 reselect-vs-ready rounds) — fixture serializeTx suites are unit-level only and not claimed as production-isolation proof. Zone-legal automatic setup places sidekicks on separate free cells sharing the hero zone for both seed orientations; firstPlayerId persisted in compact state. Player-chosen start zone and UE hit-test remain outside this task; full ACC-017 not closed.

GD-018.acceptanceScope: Strict sequential pendingEffects queue: head+owner enforced, invalid/foreign/out-of-order/replayed rejected without mutation, decline restricted to optional (mandatory decline rejected — mandatory choices are never silently discarded), combat continuation and staged maneuver preserved, second action and turn transfer deferred until drain (single transfer, +1 seq per mutation), combat timeout never fabricates queue decisions, persistence roundtrip. Zero-step MOVE is a legal resolve for 'up to N' (covers mandatory MOVE with no reachable free cell for any client); AI declines optional heads with no improving step (adjacent/blocked) and resolves mandatory heads with a zero step — full AiTurnService drain with adjacent fighters transfers exactly once; AI coverage of choice classes (CHOOSE_ONE/MOVE/PLACE) is engine-level, not an HTTP e2e VS_AI match. PLACE/MOVE reject grid holes, blocked cells and living fighters uniformly (isCellPassable, isLivingFighter). declinePendingEffect exposed to web client (own-only queue counter) and admin tester.
